# Self-Improving Agent Protocol

## Purpose
Enable agents to autonomously identify gaps and request new capabilities.

## Improvement Loop

### 1. Gap Detection
- Task failed due to missing knowledge
- Repeated similar issues across tasks
- User feedback indicates capability gap

### 2. Analysis
- Categorize the gap (domain, tool, process)
- Identify root cause in training/skills
- Determine solution approach

### 3. Request Generation
- Create specific skill/concept request
- Include use cases and examples
- Prioritize by impact

## Memory Integration
Patterns stored in `/memories/repo/self-improving/` trigger automatic skill proposals.
